title: MIVA breaks the silence with new single “Sanity”
htmlContent: MIVA, an independent producer, songwriter, and artist from Montreal, is back with "Sanity," a powerful new release that feels more like a moment of revelation than a song. MIVA is known for creating a sound world based on emotional gravity and growing self-awareness. With a new song that hums with introspection, tension, and magnetic presence, that world keeps getting bigger. "Sanity" is like a confession whispered in the dark, which is measured, open, and not afraid to sit with the truth. MIVA expertly creates the song's mood with a mix of steady, hypnotic production and a vocal performance that feels both emotionally raw and controlled, which reflects the song's internal struggle. Every beat and change in melody feels planned, like the push and pull between order and disorder, fear and determination. https://open.spotify.com/track/0fwY39B9EcCUO6Wxq9wGGI The song reflects emotional turmoil, but its true strength comes from the sense of growth that runs through it. MIVA shows how to get through instability. The music moves like someone who is facing their fears and building something stronger on the other side. "Sanity" becomes magnetic when it finds that balance between being fragile and growing. "Sanity" feels like another chapter in the powerful story she's been slowly telling, one where evolution isn't just a theme but something that happens in real life. The result is a piece of music that stays with you long after the last note, making you feel like you've seen something real and changing in real time. Follow MIVA on Instagram
